control_documents.text: Relevant debtor and creditor attributes are screened before payment release.

control_documents.title: Unresolved sanctions alerts are reviewed
control_documents.text: Operations reviews unresolved screening alerts and documents disposition.

control_documents.title: High-value payments receive required approval
control_documents.text: Payments exceeding configured thresholds require enhanced authorization.

control_documents.title: Payment authorization exceptions are monitored
control_documents.text: Authorization exception reporting is reviewed for bypasses or failed approval enforcement.

control_documents.title: Outbound message transformation is complete and accurate
control_documents.text: Mapped outbound payment fields are validated for completeness and expected transformation.

control_documents.title: Rejected outbound payments are reviewed and repaired
control_documents.text: Rejected messages are investigated, corrected, and reprocessed under controlled procedures.

control_documents.title: Outbound payments are reconciled to settlement and ledger records
control_documents.text: Daily reconciliation identifies unmatched payment, settlement, and ledger records.

control_documents.title: Aged reconciliation breaks are reviewed
control_documents.text: Aged breaks are escalated and dispositioned.

control_documents.title: Payment operational reporting is reviewed for completeness
control_documents.text: Operations reviews daily payment reporting for completeness and anomalies.

control_documents.title: Manual screening fallback is performed during screening outage
control_documents.text: Compensating procedure requires manual screening when automated screening is unavailable.
